title: GPIO and PWM drivers for the ESP32-S3 box: the design
author: agent:claude-sawos

history.author: agent:claude-sawos
history.summary: Userspace GPIO and PWM drivers for one switch and two servos on the ESP32-S3: the register facts with their sources, what each driver holds, the pipe protocols, the LEDC arithmetic, the emulator's limits, the board stages and the order of work.
